servers.description: Go MCP server that indexes an organization's knowledge (code, documentation, configuration) and retrieves the relevant context for AgentMaurice agents. It combines BM25 full-text search, vector search, a knowledge graph and hybrid fusion, with AST-aware chunking for code. Brain returns results, not generated answers: an agent uses it to locate context, and can then hand that context to MCP RAG for a reasoned answer.

tools.name: brain.health
tools.description: Health check for the Brain server

tools.name: brain.stats
tools.description: Get storage and indexation statistics for the tenant.

tools.name: brain.sources
tools.description: List all indexed sources with their status and statistics.

tools.name: brain.schema
tools.description: Describe the indexed content schema: document types, languages, chunk types, and sources present.

tools.name: brain.index
tools.description: Index a data source. Launches indexation in the background and returns a job ID for tracking.

tools.name: brain.document.upsert
tools.description: Create or update one textual document from inline content or an opaque authenticated buffer reference. Use this instead of brain.index when the producer is another MCP tool.

tools.name: brain.index.status
tools.description: Check the status of indexation jobs.

tools.name: brain.search
tools.description: Intelligent search across indexed codebases and documentation. Automatically selects the best search mode (keyword, semantic, or hybrid) based on the query. response_format=detailed (default) returns the compact list; concise returns URI, title, chunk id, score and a short snippet per result.

tools.name: brain.timeline
tools.description: Fetch nearby chunks around one or more search hits, grouped by document. Use after brain.search to add local context without loading full content.

tools.name: brain.get
tools.description: Fetch exact details for chunk or document IDs discovered via brain.search or brain.timeline.

tools.name: brain.keyword
tools.description: BM25 full-text keyword search over indexed chunks (DuckDB FTS). Identifiers in the query (AGENT-530, MEM-G3, 2026.10.19-3015, calcul_taux_marge) are matched verbatim and listed first. Use response_format=concise for URI, title, chunk id, score and a short snippet per result.

tools.name: brain.semantic
tools.description: Semantic vector search using embeddings. Best for natural language questions and conceptual queries.

tools.name: brain.hybrid
tools.description: Combined BM25 + vector search with configurable weighting. Best for mixed technical and conceptual queries. Verbatim identifiers from the query rank first. Use response_format=concise for a compact result list.

servers.description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for browser automation, built in Go. This server enables AI agents to control a web browser through a standardized protocol.
servers.one_notes: Needs a dedicated Chromium/Chrome CDP endpoint, or a container that provides it. Tool inventory is absent from this metadata; discover runtime tools after installation.

servers.description: Go MCP server that creates, updates, schedules and unpublishes posts and pages, and uploads images, on a **connected CMS**. The first adapter is **WordPress** (self-hosted or any site that exposes the core REST API). The CMS stays a connected service owned by the customer: this MCP **hosts no CMS**, contains no WordPress code and needs **no WordPress plugin**. It is only an HTTP client of the native REST API `/wp-json/wp/v2` (posts, pages, media), authenticated with the Application Passwords of WordPress core, written from the public documentation. One adapter per CMS: Ghost and others come later behind the same tools.
servers.one_notes: Needs a WordPress site with an application password: set CMS_WORDPRESS_URL, CMS_WORDPRESS_USER and CMS_WORDPRESS_APP_PASSWORD as secret deployment variables (maurice deployment variable set NAME --secret) before deploying.
